data.rationale: The proposed workflow matches the true procedure in order and goal (Gutenberg search, note release date and downloads, Wikipedia author lookup, then a new note with the 'Read:' text). It is weaker on feasibility: it wrongly lists derived values (life years, release date, download count) as parameters, and it omits the "do not download" constraint, the "open the matching book by {author}" disambiguation, and the tab-switching. It also leaves the author-article opening vague.
